# BeJo

> BeJo is a free Android app that announces incoming QRIS payments out loud in
> Indonesian, built for warung, kiosk, and small-shop owners in Indonesia. When
> a payment arrives the phone chimes and speaks the amount ("dua ratus ribu
> rupiah"), so the merchant knows the money landed without stopping to look at
> the screen.

Key facts:

- Free to use. No activation fee and no monthly rental, unlike subscription
  "soundbox" devices that many QRIS merchants rent.
- Replaces a soundbox: the merchant's existing phone does the announcing.
- Works on Android 7.0 and newer.
- Reads payment notifications from 40+ bank and e-wallet apps (GoPay, Dana,
  OVO, ShopeePay, BCA, BRI, Mandiri and others), filtering out promos.
- The announcement voice is changeable, which competing apps and soundboxes do
  not allow. More than 10 voices, adjustable speed, and custom sound packs.
- Other features: sales records with daily and monthly summaries, cash entry
  with a calculator-style keypad, QRIS management including a code with the
  amount pre-filled that can be shared over WhatsApp, per-employee QRIS, team
  accounts with location-based attendance, inventory, home-screen widgets, and
  a fingerprint lock.
- Optional, off by default: merchants can opt in to receive short voice ads
  from brands, which is how the product is funded.

Install: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.temanproduk.bejo
Contact: moobejo@gmail.com

## Pages

- [Beranda](https://bejo.temanproduk.com/): what BeJo does, how the voice
  announcement works, QRIS billing over chat apps, team and attendance, sales
  records, and how to get started.
- [Banding Harga](https://bejo.temanproduk.com/perbandingan.html): cost and
  capability comparison against GoPay Soundbox, Flip Soundbox, Netzme Soundbox,
  DANA Bisnis, GoPay Merchant, and Merchant BCA, across activation fee, rental
  fee, notification reliability, and whether the voice can be changed.
- [Untuk Brand](https://bejo.temanproduk.com/brand.html): voice ad campaigns
  for brands wanting to reach grassroots merchants, including how targeting and
  reporting work. The self-serve dashboard is not open yet; campaigns are
  arranged directly and there is a waitlist.
- [Hubungi Kami](https://bejo.temanproduk.com/contact.html): how to reach the
  team.

## Legal

- [Kebijakan Privasi](https://bejo.temanproduk.com/privacy.html): what data is
  collected, how notification access and location are used, analytics, and
  retention.
- [Hapus Data](https://bejo.temanproduk.com/data-deletion.html): how to request
  deletion of an account and its data by emailing moobejo@gmail.com.
